question: Does replacing exact immediate-context occurrence-count signatures with exact observed-context support signatures restore alias abstraction under independent finite samples from the same latent distribution without collapsing distinct entities?
hypothesis: If R2 failed specifically because exact counts encode sampling noise, discarding positive count magnitudes while retaining the exact observed context keys will induce exactly nine correct three-member alias classes and at least 0.90 task-untrained family-2 transfer accuracy in the independent-sample arm. The exact-count replication control must reproduce R2 fragmentation, and the matched-sample support control must retain nine correct classes and at least 0.95 transfer accuracy.

prior_evidence.observation: Matched exact-count signatures formed nine correct triplets with 1.0 transfer; independent samples formed twenty-seven singleton classes, produced eighty missing transitions, and yielded 0.0 transfer while the exact-surface control yielded 0.0625.

scope_statement: This experiment changes exactly one representation dimension: context occurrence maps are projected to their positive-count key support before exact equality comparison. Sampling, task data, capacity, learner, evaluator, and all budgets remain the frozen R2 construction.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

arms_and_inputs.matched_support: R2 matched sampler seeds; signatures are sorted sets of observed immediate-context keys with counts discarded
arms_and_inputs.independent_support: R2 family-specific independent sampler seeds; signatures are sorted sets of observed immediate-context keys with counts discarded
arms_and_inputs.independent_exact_count_control: R2 family-specific independent sampler seeds; signatures retain complete exact occurrence counts
arms_and_inputs.underlying_distribution: uniform over context_index 0..15 for every family and entity
arms_and_inputs.matched_seed: 0x243f6a88 XOR ((entity+1)*1009); identical sequence for all families of an entity
arms_and_inputs.independent_seed: 0x243f6a88 XOR ((entity+1)*1009) XOR ((family+1)*0x9e3779b9); distinct deterministic sequence per family
arms_and_inputs.task_training: families 0 and 1 only; exactly 3200 frozen R2 single-step records
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: all eighty family-2 single-step tasks, read-only

representation_and_prediction.surface_selection: top twenty-seven raw four-byte bridge windows by occurrence count descending then lexicographic raw key, selected from the matched bridge exactly as R2
representation_and_prediction.support_signature: complete sorted set of immediate-context keys having positive occurrence count; count magnitudes are discarded; equality remains exact
representation_and_prediction.transition_model: dynamic exact induced-class transition counts, identical to R2
representation_and_prediction.missing_transition_behavior: predict lexicographically lowest observed output-class pair, identical to R2

controls: Independent exact-count arm must reproduce R2's twenty-seven classes, zero correct triplets, eighty missing transitions, and 0.0 transfer.
Matched support arm uses identical finite samples across aliases and must retain nine correct triplets and at least 0.95 transfer.
Independent support arm differs from the exact-count control only by projecting positive context counts to presence bits.
All arms use the same selected surfaces, motifs, samples, task records, transition learner, fallback, and evaluator.

No family label, semantic label, alias dictionary, tokenizer, external model, network access, capacity growth, fuzzy similarity, distance threshold, oracle correction, or adaptive repair enters learning.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R2 probe reproduces its frozen bridge, representation, control, and outcome metrics before any R3 scientific output is emitted.
Support signatures are derived only by replacing every positive count in the R2 immediate-context occurrence map with presence; no context key is added or removed by any other rule.
All arms use identical frozen R2 data generation, surface selection, task data, learner, fallback, and evaluator.
Family 2 contributes zero task-transition records and semantic identity remains evaluator-only after prediction.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, distance threshold, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.support_abstraction_supported: Validity and all controls pass; independent support has nine correct triplets, zero cross-entity collisions, zero missing transitions, and at least 0.90 transfer.
classification_rules.support_abstraction_falsified: Validity and controls pass, but independent support fragments aliases, collapses distinct entities, has missing transitions, or transfer accuracy is at most 0.25.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but independent support behavior lies between the supported and falsified rules.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: The exact-count replication or matched-support control fails a frozen threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R2 replication, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R3 output begins, complete all three arms and all eighty family-2 evaluations per learner unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not alter samples, seeds, support rule, task data, capacity, budgets, metrics, thresholds, or classification after observing R3 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No context distribution, sample count, seed, representation rule, learner, control, metric, threshold, budget, capacity, or interpretation may change after primary R3 output.
